title: Windows 10 Upgrade (Official Dell Tech Support)
description: How to perform a Windows 10 Upgrade on your Dell computer.   Upgrade to Windows 10 from Windows 8.1 with this simple step by step video from Dell Tech Support.  Prior to upgrade, visit http://www.dell.com/support/article/us/en/19/SLN297954/en and check if your Dell system is compatible for upgrade.  Also ensure backing up your critical data before upgrading your Windows.   For more information please visit http://dell.com/support For support questions email us at [EMAIL]  If in case “Get Windows 10” app does not appear on your Windows, visit Microsoft support link https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/kb/3081048#/en-us/kb/3081048

asr.full_text: Welcome to Dell Tech Support. In this video, we will show you how to upgrade from Windows 8.1 to Windows 10. But before we start the process, there are a few things that you need to do first. The first thing is, check to see if your system is on the list of those compatible to receive the Windows 10 upgrade. For Dell systems, check out our updated list by clicking on the link in the description below. For any other systems, you should check with your manufacturer's website. The second is that it's important to have all your drivers updated. And the third is to be sure that you have the most current version of Windows 8.1 on your computer. You can do this by going to the Start menu and type Windows Update and click on the proper icon. Click on Check for Updates to see if there are any updates listed. Click on Install for the ones you need and wait for this step to be completed. This is a good time to mention that it is also highly recommended to backup all of your critical data. If you need help with this, you can watch our video at this link. The next thing to do is to look for the Windows 10 icon on your taskbar and click on it. If you don't have the icon, then you should go to the Microsoft support link listed in the description below. The upgrade process should start automatically. Now, wait for it to download completely. Once it's finished, a screen will appear with the Microsoft license terms. Read the terms, and if you agree, click Accept. Next, Windows informs you that the upgrade is ready to be installed. Be sure to have your computer plugged in directly to a power source so you don't run the risk of it shutting down during the installation. Now click Start Update and your computer will restart. Wait for the next steps. Welcome to Windows 10. In the first screen, click Next. You will see a Use Express Settings screen with some new applications. Click Next. You are now ready to log in and then wait for Windows 10 to configure your profile. Once this is done, you are ready to enjoy your new version of Windows. Thank you for watching this Dell Tech Support video and please check out our other helpful hints and tutorials on this channel.
